abilities.name: Flowfire Blade
abilities.caveat: Shown for the full 12s, but the Nightsoul state empties in about 6s unless the burst refreshes it.
_curatorNotes: Tap E (Flowfire Blade Tap): hits enemy at skillTapHitmark=24f, then enters NS Blessing at +19f (enterNightsoulDelay). Initiates a Blazing Threshold pulse loop at 66f intervals (blazingThresholdInterval). Per-pulse blazingThreshold[lvl=10]=50.54% ATK Pyro.

Hold E variant: skillHoldHitmark=50f for the explicit Hold DMG (holdDMG[lvl=10]=177.84% ATK Pyro). Also enters NS Blessing + opens Scorching Threshold state (which fires 81.4% ATK Pyro on enemy hit, 3s ICD per scorchingThresholdICDKey).
Cooldown: SetCDWithDelay(skill, 18*60, tapCdStart=19 / holdCdStart=48).
Frames Tap: skillFrames[0]=InitAbilSlice(49), ActionDash/Jump=31 ActionSwap=48. Per E-spec swap/N/Q/D/J — N/Q default to animLen=49.
Hold variant frames: skillHoldFrames[0]=InitAbilSlice(77), ActionAttack=61 ActionBurst/Swap=59 ActionDash=60 ActionJump=61. Per E-spec — Q/swap=59.

NS exit: EnterTimedBlessing with 12s timer + ConsumePoints from cast frame. exitNightsoul fires when timer expires OR points reach 0. terminatesOnSwap:false — NS persists off-field (Burst can re-trigger NS gain).
C2 (Spreading Flames): on E cast, +30% ATK to active for 8s. Authorable; skipped for terseness.
C4 (Brightening Embers): +30% Q DMG when in NS Blessing. Authorable as conditional buff effect; skipped.
[A7] Flavor context: Traveler is the only non-Natlan character to use the Nightsoul system — worth mentioning to explain why the drain/refresh mechanics matter.
[A7] The burst restores 7 Nightsoul points per refresh, up to 4 times (+28 total, filling toward the 42 cap); the per-refresh amount is already detailed in the burst's curator notes.

↻ CAVEAT TRIMMED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass): kept only the on-screen half. Full prior text: "Shown for the full 12s, but the Nightsoul state drains at 7 points/sec from a max of 42 — empty in about 6s unless refreshed. The burst restores points up to 4 times; the drain and refresh are not modeled."
abilities.description:
The Traveler unleashes their inner flame, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.

Tap
Deals AoE Pyro DMG, enters Nightsoul's Blessing, and produces Blazing Threshold pulses at intervals.

Hold
Deals stronger AoE Pyro DMG and enters Nightsoul's Blessing with the Scorching Threshold effect: when nearby opponents take damage, a Pyro pulse triggers.

abilities.name: Plains Scorcher
_curatorNotes: Burst hit at burstHitmark=40f: 768.96% ATK Pyro at lvl=10 (burst multiplier).

Restores 7 NS Blessing points to Traveler 4 times at delays [42, 52, 59, 59] frames after cast. Cumulative +28 NS points (filling up to max 42). Not authored as a separate effect — refresh-NS-on-cast doesn't fit a clean trigger primitive.
Burst frames: burstFrames[0]=InitAbilSlice(49), ActionSkill=48 ActionSwap=47. Per Q-spec swap/N/E/D/J — N/D/J default to animLen=49.
Cooldown: SetCD(burst, 18*60). EnergyMax=70. ConsumeEnergy(19) drains 19 energy from teammates.
C4 effect on burst (+30% Q DMG when in NS): not authored — would need conditional effect with state:nightsoulBlessing condition.
abilities.description: Releases all the Pyro power within, dealing massive AoE Pyro DMG and restoring Nightsoul points to the Traveler.

notModeled.reason: The Rotation Planner doesn't track Nightsoul points, so it doesn't draw the points Plains Scorcher restores.

passives.name: True Flame of Incineration
_curatorNotes: A larger Threshold AoE above 20 Nightsoul points — no pixel; description-only. ⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15 from genshin-db: the hand-written passives ('Resounding Battlecries', 'Crackling Adversity') were invented, though this one's mechanic was right.
passives.description: When the Traveler has over 20 Nightsoul points, the attack AoE of the Blazing and Scorching Thresholds from the Elemental Skill Flowfire Blade after they hit opponents is increased.

passives.name: Embers Unspent
_curatorNotes: gcsim asc.go `a4Init`: 5 Energy when the ACTIVE character's attack triggers a Pyro-related reaction while the Traveler's Nightsoul's Blessing is up (the Thresholds live exactly that long), once per 12s — `source: 'active'` is the same rule Fischl's A4 states. The +4 Energy on a nearby party member's Nightsoul Burst has no trigger in the vocabulary and is description-only.
passives.description: After the current active character inside a Blazing Threshold or Scorching Threshold triggers a Pyro-related reaction, the Traveler will regain 5 Energy. This can occur once every 12s. Additionally, when a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, the Traveler will regain 4 Energy.

constellations.name: Starfire's Flowing Light
constellations.caveat: Shown for the full 12s; it ends when the Nightsoul state empties (about 6s unless the burst refreshes it). The extra 9% for a character in their own Nightsoul's Blessing is not drawn.
_curatorNotes: gcsim cons.go `c1Init`: an attack mod on every party member — +6% DMG while they are ACTIVE and the Traveler's Nightsoul's Blessing (the Threshold) is up, +9% more if the receiver is in their own Nightsoul's Blessing. Authored as the 6% active-target bar for the Threshold's life; the +9% needs a receiver-side state no Condition expresses. ⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15: the retired entry ('Burning Resolve', +14 Nightsoul cap) was invented.
constellations.description: While Blazing Threshold or Scorching Threshold are active, the current active character deals 6% increased DMG. If said character is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, they will deal an additional 9% DMG.

constellations.name: Ever-Lit Candle
_curatorNotes: Nightsoul point regeneration off party Pyro reactions inside 12s of the skill (gcsim `c2OnSkill`, two activations per cast). Nightsoul points are not modelled; description-only. ⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15: the retired entry ('Spreading Flames', +30% ATK) was invented.
constellations.description: Within 12s of using the Elemental Skill Flowfire Blade, after nearby party members trigger a Pyro-related reaction on an opponent, the Traveler will regain 14 Nightsoul points. Each use of Flowfire Blade will restore at most 28 Nightsoul points in this way.

notModeled.reason: The Rotation Planner doesn't track Nightsoul points, so it doesn't draw the points this restores.

constellations.name: The Sacred Flame Imperishable
constellations.caveat: Shown for the full 12s; both end when the Nightsoul state empties. The +40% CRIT DMG applies to Normal, Charged and Plunging Attacks only.
_curatorNotes: gcsim cons.go `c6Init`: Normal/Charged/Plunging attacks carrying the Nightsoul tag get +40% CRIT DMG, and in game those attacks are converted to Pyro while Nightsoul's Blessing is up. Authored as the Cryo Traveler's Ever-Keen Frost shape — an onCast-skill `infuse` for the state's 12s maximum — plus a self CRIT DMG bar over the same window (no attack-class CRIT stat exists; the caveat names the classes). ⚠️ Re-ingested 2026-09-15: the retired entry ('Final Bloom', +30% burst CRIT Rate) was invented.
constellations.description: While in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, the Traveler's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will be converted to Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG that cannot be overridden, and the CRIT DMG of these attacks is increased by 40%.
